French onion pasta soup
4 yellow onions, diced
4 lbs beef broth (64oz)
1 stick unsalted butter 
2 tbsps Worcestershire sauce 
2 tbsps all purpose flour 
Fresh thyme
2 bay leaves
2 tsps salt & pepper, add more to your liking
1/4 cup white wine
2 cups ditalini or any small shape pasta
Sliced bread
Gruyère cheese, freshly grated

In a large pot, melt butter on medium heat. Once it starts bubbling, add onions, salt and pepper and mix occasionally for 30 minutes on medium low heat. After 30 minutes, add Worcestershire sauce and turn to medium high heat stirring more frequently for 20 minutes. Once golden deglaze with white wine. Add flour, broth, thyme and bay leaves, and once simmering, add pasta. Cover and simmer on medium for another 8-10 minutes till pasta is cooked. Serve with cheesy bread, more Gruyère and enjoy!
